FN-LS66AWA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 5
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/12/2025
House Bill 5 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) by an estimated $52,400 in Fiscal Year 2025 and an estimated $3.8 million in
Fiscal Year 2026 and each fiscal year thereafter to pay the increased salary and benefits for
certain law enforcement officers employed by the ALEA covered by the provisions of this bill.
